newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end low as blue chips fall.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end low as blue chips fall.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended lower after blue chips fell on selling pressure on Monday's clearing day and are likely to open lower on Tuesday's new accounts day owing to selling pressure, dealers said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index ended 10.82 points, or 0.79 percent, lower at 1,352.19 amid 152 losers and 71 gainers in a turnover of 11.8 million shares, up from Sunday's 8.8 million.
Short-covering before the close could not change the bearish sentiment, dealer Faisal Abbas said. Foreign investors were net sellers and local funds remained quiet amid bearish sentiment.
The decline in the index and the falling volume were reflecting the slide, dealer Asif Janmohammad said.

Knoll (Boots) Pharma fell 7.50 rupees to 141, Singer 20 to 100, Wellcome 10 to 100, Fauji Fertilizer 3.10 to 63.35, KESC 1.00 to 23.25, PTCL 0.40 to 33.60 and HUBCO 0.05 to 29.45. Engro Chemical rose 4.00 to 140 and Pakland Cement 1.00 to 14.
